status: Question and criteria draft; gold evidence annotations and retrieval baseline not implemented
seed_policy: Graph-selected records are inspection aids, not ground truth; review raw source records and complete sections independently before scoring.
annotation_protocol: Review raw DSLD label statements and NatMed source sections, including relevant context and qualifications.
Record relevant source spans and source IDs first; then record whether each is preserved/exported/linked in the graph.
Label gaps as source_missing, collected_not_exported, exported_not_linked, or retrieval_miss; keep these separate.
Determine expected answerability and exclusions. Record reviewer/date and adjudicate unclear cases.
Do not restrict the relevant set to the example seed IDs or the baseline retriever output.
Only score frozen reviewed annotations. Future train/test splits must keep related labels, shared excerpts and threads together to avoid leakage.

metrics.retrieval_precision: Relevant retrieved evidence units / all retrieved evidence units
metrics.retrieval_recall: Relevant retrieved evidence units / all adjudicated relevant evidence units in the specified saved-source scope
metrics.unit: Annotate source-specific evidence units: label assertion/span, NatMed claim/span, or Reddit record. Deduplicate repeated returns by the agreed unit; keep distinct source contexts.
metrics.empty_sets: No returned evidence: precision undefined (report N/A). No relevant evidence: recall undefined (report N/A); score answerability/abstention separately.
additional: Correct source attribution and preserved qualifications
metrics.aggregation: Report per-question and per-source scores, then macro averages over defined denominators; keep answerability separate. No measured scores yet.
